ideas.name: Price-to-new-addresses ratio value effect
ideas.claim: Coins with a high price relative to new on-chain addresses earn lower future returns in the cross-section.
ideas.quote: Lastly, we construct the price-to-new address ratios and show that they negatively predict future cryptocurrency returns, which we refer to as the cryptocurrency value effect.

rules.entry: rank coins by price-to-new-address ratio; low ratio favoured, high ratio disfavoured

required_data: public blockchain new-address counts per coin

ideas.name: USDT exchange net inflows predict BTC ETH returns
ideas.claim: USDT moving from wallets into exchanges positively predicts BTC and ETH returns at 1-6 hour horizons.
ideas.quote: USDT net inflows into the exchanges, positively predicts BTC and ETH returns at multiple intervals and negatively predicts ETH volatility at various intervals and BTC volatility at the 6-hour interval.

rules.entry: USDT net inflow to exchanges as long signal

required_data: on-chain USDT exchange net inflow data

ideas.name: ETH on-chain net inflows predict ETH returns
ideas.claim: ETH net inflows negatively predict ETH returns and volatility at all intraday intervals.
ideas.quote: Second, we find that ETH net inflows negatively predict ETH returns and volatility for all intraday intervals.

rules.entry: ETH net inflow to exchanges as short/bearish signal

required_data: on-chain ETH exchange net inflow data

ideas.name: Network distribution factor explains crypto returns
ideas.claim: A two-factor model of market plus network distribution factor built from on-chain data explains cross-section of coin returns.
ideas.quote: can explain the cross-section of individual cryptocurrency returns.
